text:
ira: Heads-up — need to borrow 4x A100s overnight for the demo cluster (demo-west2). Vendor said racks arriving but serials not posted yet. @sam can you confirm if we can soft-claim standby slots for 00:00-08:00 PST on 2024-05-15? Also planning to run a quick terraform smoke: `terraform apply -target=module.demo_pool` — will that touch prod?

sam: On it. I’ll ping vendor and check inventory. The TF target should be safe in theory but depends on how module.demo_pool refs shared resources. What’s the tenant id?

ira: tenant-redwood-demo-3

maria: FYI nightly canary runs land in that window. If we take 4, we need strict isolation. Could you set `spot_preemptible = true` for the demo_pool so we get soft pricing & lower tenant risk?

sam: looping in vendor now. Quick note: if we soft-claim, the slot is provisional and can be bumped by higher-priority orders. I'll try to get a hard-commit.

devops-bot: Soft-claim created: standby-slot id slb-772 for demo-west2 by ira, expires in 6h. Claim metadata: {"size":"4xA100","tenant":"tenant-redwood-demo-3"} (internal token displayed only to infra).

sam: Vendor (alpha-cloud) replied — racks ETA ~02:00 PST, they will post serials to vendor-portal. They included a quick status endpoint, example: `curl -s https://vendor.alpha/cloud/slots/slb-772 | jq .`

maria: Can we reduce to 2x A100? Cost team flagged nightly burst as expensive.

ira: Prefer 4 to run parallel demos, but ok to stagger if vendor only grants 2. @sam if they can’t confirm 4, please book 2 and add a follow-up window at 04:00 for the second pair.

sam: Will confirm by 00:30. Also opening a tiny PR to set `demo_pool.size = var.demo_request` so we can flip between 2/4 without full apply — link coming.

maria: sounds good. If vendor posts serials, ops can pre-authorize subnet & DRs.

ira: thanks — appreciate the urgency. If anyone sees the vendor portal update, drop the link here. :thumbsup:

sam: added vendor portal link: https://vendor.alpha/slots/slb-772 (private). PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/pull/842 (wip).

maria: :eyes: will watch the PR and can approve quick if TF change is trivial.

sam: updating thread after vendor confirms hard-commit or if we need to scale down.

ira: perfect — cheers everyone.
